text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about road safety and speeding along Balsam Avenue. My office polled the homes near the intersection of Balsam Avenue and Sycamore Place and residents supported creating an all way stop at this intersection. To keep making our community safer for all, I recommend installing an all-way stop at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop controls at the intersection of Balsam Avenue and Sycamore Place.
